title: To Err Is Human; To Annotate, SILICON? Reducing Measurement Error in LLM Annotation
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical methodology (SILICON) for reducing measurement error in Large Language Model (LLM) text annotation across several management research tasks. Although 'language toxicity detection' is used as one of the seven case studies, the paper's core objective is to improve annotation reliability and reproducibility rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
